source_text: δωρεὰ γὰρ ἡ διδασκαλία τῆς θεοσεβείας, χάρις δὲ ἡ πίστις. ποιοῦντες γὰρ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ τὸ θέλημα γινώσκομεν.
pass_a_gloss: For a gift is the teaching of the godliness, and a grace is the faith. For doing the will of the God the will we-know.
pass_b_english: For the teaching of godliness is a gift, and faith itself is grace. By doing the will of God we come to know the will.

choices.why: Keep source term concrete in Pass B.
